title: Not Eligible | ASL | Employee AC
description:
Customer is an Air Canada employee on an employee booking flying to Israel. Employee bookings are NOT eligible for compensation under ANY regime � ASL included. Validates that DDS detects the employee booking flag and returns Not Eligible before any ASL assessment. 

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (AC employee), 1 leg AC operated YYZ?TLV. Employee booking flag: TRUE in PNR. Itinerary: Scheduled arrival 06:00, Actual arrival 10:00 (4hr delay). Disruption code: 42 (Controllable). Booking type: Employee/staff travel. Route context: Canada departure ? APPR; Israel arrival ? ASL.
